extensions.scope: Website only (website/). The macOS app UI is documented in CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md.

display.purpose: The one statement per page; the hero headline is a comp-measured instance of it.

headline.purpose: Section titles, max about 16ch, balanced wrap.

lead.purpose: One short paragraph under a headline, in Haze.

body.purpose: Copy under titles, in Dusk Grey, 34 to 52ch.

label.purpose: Notes, captions, spec line, footer credits.

shadows.name: capture-lift
shadows.purpose: filter on every real app capture below the hero.

shadows.name: hero-window
shadows.purpose: filter on the tilted hero window; the amber term is the icon's light landing.

shadows.name: pip-halo
shadows.purpose: filter on the lit seventh chevron (0 0.4cqw 2cqw at 0.7 in the large scroll variant).

shadows.name: nav-glass
shadows.value: background: rgb(10 11 26 / 0.72); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.6) blur(18px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(214 219 229 / 0.08)
shadows.purpose: fixed header, faded in over the first 140px of scroll.

shadows.name: stage-dot-cutout
shadows.purpose: box-shadow ring that cuts a stage dot out of its hairline; not an elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: shared easing for every state change and the load choreography.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: pill background, border and press scale (0.98).

motion.name: pip-flash
motion.purpose: six unlit chevrons flash white and settle on load.

motion.name: light-land
motion.purpose: icon brightens, window warms, glow and rim fade in.

motion.name: scroll-driven
motion.purpose: section rise, origin re-lock, relay track emptying, nav glass.

motion.name: motion-gate
motion.value: .motion class set before first paint unless prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: default styles are the final state; reduced motion shows the locked page.

breakpoints.name: stage-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: nav, hero and signing-path columns become a single column.

breakpoints.name: split-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: section grids collapse to one column (900 Local, 960 Phone, Portals, Zako, 1000 Signing).

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: remaining two-column lists become one column.

breakpoints.name: comp-width
breakpoints.purpose: the reference width the first viewport's cqw values are measured against.

narrative.northStar: The Moment the Seventh Chevron Locks
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Moment the Seventh Chevron Locks"**

The site is a dark room lit by one lamp. A near-black midnight ground carries cool white type at very large sizes, and the only warm light on the page comes from the lit seventh chevron and the glass app icon, which casts amber down onto a real app window. The product is shown as itself: real captures from the app (DEMO mode, labeled), never an illustrated interface.

Density is low and the pace is Apple-product-page slow: one idea per section, big bold headlines, short leads, then a real screen. Structure comes from hairlines and short grey rules, not boxes. There are no cards, no tinted panels and no feature grid of icons; section content sits directly on the ground.

Motion tells a single story. On load the six grey chevrons flash one by one, the seventh ignites amber and the icon's light lands on the window; further down, scroll-driven animation repeats the lock and empties the relay's time track. The default state is always the final, fully visible one.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight ground, cool white type in four quiet steps, one amber light source.
Seven chevron pips as the one recurring mark; the seventh is always the lit one.
Real app windows as the product imagery, lifted by soft drop shadows.
Pill buttons in a white-primary / hairline-outline pair.
Hairline dividers and short grey rules instead of cards.
Motion that lands on the locked state and is skipped entirely under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Amber is light, not a brand fill. It appears only where the seventh chevron or its glow lands, plus focus and selection. A second accent hue, or amber on a button or background, breaks the world.

rules.name: The Quiet Steps Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy among text is carried by the four white steps (text-0 to text-3), never by color.

rules.name: The Size Not Style Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is size, weight and white step. Tracking tightens with size, from -0.01em at 19px titles to -0.035em at display; body, leads and labels stay at normal tracking and in sentence case.

rules.name: The Light Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Only real app captures and the lit chevron cast anything. Text and layout blocks stay flat on the ground.

dos: **Do** keep amber for the lit seventh chevron, its glow, focus and selection (The One Light Rule).
**Do** show the product through real app captures from DEMO mode, lifted with the capture drop shadow.
**Do** pair a white pill with a hairline pill for calls to action, white first.
**Do** separate content with 1px hairlines and the short 40 by 3px grey rule.
**Do** make the final, locked state the default and add motion only under the `.motion` class, so reduced motion shows the finished page.
**Do** use the four white steps for hierarchy: Signal White titles, Haze leads, Dusk Grey body.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent color or fill buttons and backgrounds with amber.
**Don't** put section content in cards, tinted panels or bordered boxes; the ground carries it.
**Don't** replace real captures with illustrated or invented app interfaces.
**Don't** use more or fewer than seven chevrons, or light any chevron other than the seventh.
